title: Power Apps: modern, refreshed look reaches the mail app on the semi-annual channel
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, default and environment-channel API are supported. Minor corrections should complete the control path, acknowledge conflicting channel and licensing guidance, and remove the checklist instruction for a control absent from the table.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Semi-annual releases roll out gradually across region groups on successive weekends rather than reaching all environments on one date.
claims.quote: each semi-annual release follows the gradual weekly rollout across the same region groups, starting with the first release region and reaching each subsequent region group on the following weekend.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends the semi-annual channel for users needing more training and extensive testing before new user-facing features roll out.
claims.quote: For users in your organization where more training and extensive testing are needed before rollout out of new end user impacting features.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/pay-as-you-go-meters#how-do-meters-work alongside the FAQ, to disclose the differing licensing wording.

claims.claim: The environment channel is reached through Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Behavior.
claims.quote: In the command bar, select Settings. 6. Expand Product, and then select Behavior. ## Release channel | Settings | Description | Default value | | Model-driven app release channel
claims.fix: Set controls[0].ui.path and its rendered table path to 'Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Behavior > Release channel > Model-driven app release channel', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/settings-behavior.

claims.claim: PATCH [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organizationid>) updates the organization row used for the environment release channel.

claims.claim: The update body sets releasechannel to 3 for the Semi-annual channel.
claims.quote: | LogicalName | `releasechannel` | ... #### ReleaseChannel Choices/Options ... | 3 | **Semi-annual channel** |

claims.quote:
PATCH [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/accounts(00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001) HTTP/1.1

claims.claim: The update can use If-Match: *.
claims.quote: The `If-Match: *` header ensures you don't create a new record by accidentally performing an upsert operation.

claims.claim: The environment release channel governs feature availability, including when the mail app refresh arrives, subject to app and user settings.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/channel-change#keep-semi-annual-release-channel to disclose the conflict with the general environment-channel guidance.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: The release channel does not change the environment database version.
claims.quote: The release channel controls feature availability. It doesn't change the environment's database version or the platform and application versions deployed to the environment.

claims.claim: A per-app release channel exists in the app designer.
claims.quote: A maker can use the app designer to explicitly set the release channel for an app, which overrides the environment channel.

claims.claim: A per-user channel override exists under Users in the environment in Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Select Users > See all. ... Under the Model apps channel field, select Change channel. ... Select a channel from User channel override dropdown menu.

claims.claim: A configured user channel override takes precedence over the environment and app channels.
claims.quote: User channel override takes precedence over the environment channel and app channel. Only the browser session URL overrides the user channel override.

claims.claim: An explicit app release channel other than Auto takes precedence over the environment channel in Learn's ordering of checks.
claims.quote: 3. App release channel value other than Auto (for example, Monthly, Semi-annual). 4. Environment release channel value other than Auto (for example, Monthly, Semi-annual).

claims.claim: When the app and environment channels are both Auto, Power Apps and Dynamics 365 environments use the Monthly channel.
claims.quote: App release channel and environment release channel are both Auto. In this case, Power Apps and Dynamics 365 environments use the monthly channel.

claims.claim: A user must refresh the browser tab twice to see an environment-channel change.
claims.quote: When you change the release channel at the environment level, a user must refresh the browser tab twice to update the release channel information.

claims.claim: Learn documents a per-user ReleaseChannel column on the UserSettings table.
claims.quote: Developers can change the user release channel by updating the ReleaseChannel column value for the row in the UserSettings table.
